init_model_parallel: initialize model parallelism with a given model parallel size using fairscale MPU
get_gang: get a fairseq2 Gang for distributed training with torch.distributed and NCCL or GLOO backend
all_reduce: all-reduce a tensor across processes using sum, mean, min, max, or product operations
mean_reduce_dict: compute mean-reduced AverageMetric values from a dictionary of float lists across distributed processes
rank_zero_info: log an info message only from the global rank zero process to avoid duplicate logging
